decisions.decision: Stage A runtime locale override REVERTED — i18n is unstable due to baseLocale-vs-defaultLocale divergence
decisions.rationale: Paraglide's URL pattern table bakes baseLocale at compile time (en → no prefix; non-base → /<locale>/). Runtime override of DynamicSettings.i18n.supportedLocales can produce silent UI/state divergence (tenant marks fi as default, English UI still served on /). Reversal trades temporary perm scope for foundational stability.
